0x32.name: morphTargetCountAndFlags
0x32.evidence: ComputeMorphHandle uses (char)(2*field_32)>>1 (low 7 bits, sign-extended) as the length of the weight array a2 it sums/normalises and as the loop bound over per-target pointers; ApplyMorph tests (int8)field_32 < 0 (bit 7) to enable D3DRS_ALPHATEST (GREATER, ref 96).
0x32.summary: low 7 bits: number of morph targets/weights; bit 7: alpha test

0x34.name: positionCount
0x34.evidence: ComputeMorphHandle allocates 36*max(field_34,field_36) bytes, loops i<field_34 writing 3 floats (position) per output vertex from the 12-byte-per-vertex target arrays starting at this+80, and the per-target stride is 4*(field_36+3*field_34).
0x34.summary: number of 3-float positions per morph target

0x36.name: packedNormalCount
0x36.evidence: ComputeMorphHandle loops i<field_36 unpacking one 32-bit word per entry as three signed 10-bit values scaled by 1/512 into the normal slot of the output vertex; those words follow the 3*field_34 position floats in each target (stride 4*(field_36+3*field_34)).
0x36.summary: number of packed 10:10:10 normals per morph target

0x3A.name: triangleCount
0x3A.evidence: ApplyMorph reserves and fills 3*uint16@+0x3A vertices in the dynamic vertex buffer and loops v36 < 3*field_3A copying three indexed vertices per unit (in the one function's reserve and loop bound).
0x3A.summary: number of triangles emitted by ApplyMorph (3 vertices each)

unnamed.0x1C0: only CMoDistMorphElem::set_field_1C0 stores a2 into it; no reader.
